glosses: to reappropriate, to repossess, to reacquire

examples.text: Il restitue au concept sa mémoire matérielle, confisquée par hypostase. Il réapproprie l’idée à sa fonction première en la retirant à l’univers magico-religieux de l’imperium id(é)olâtrique.
Réapproprie-toi la technologie est une campagne collaborative menée par des personnes qui utilisent des TIC et des militant-es pour les droits humains.
Pour retrouver le bien-être mental et social, il faut se réapproprier notre humanité.

glosses: To reclaim a term that was previously used to disparage the reclaimers' own social group.

examples.text: Once a term of homophobic abuse, the term “queer” has been reappropriated as a marker for some gay, lesbian, bisexual, transgender (GLBT), and other marginalized sexual identities.
The term 'People of the Book' has been reappropriated as a means of self-identification by Jews and by the members of certain Christian denominations.
